caption: The drawing is done in black and red ink on a yellowed, aged paper background. It contains two views of a settee: a front view on the left and a side view on the right. The settee has a high, curved backrest, rolled arms, and cabriole legs ending in claw and ball feet. Red lines with measurements in inches are drawn horizontally and vertically across the drawing. The dimensions indicated in the drawing include: 67 1/2" for the width of the backrest, 57" for the seat length, 45" for the overall height, 17" for the seat depth, 16 1/2" for the armrest height, 14 1/2" for the backrest segment above the seat, 24 1/2" from the floor to the armrest, and 14" from the floor to the seat. At the bottom of the drawing, there is red writing denoting the scale as 1 1/2" = 1', the settee number (32.51.1), room number (30), location (Metro Museum), the name John Dieterich, and the date April 6, 1936.
title: Settee
